summary: Dismiss Inbox items with middle-click in the terminal UI

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing keyboard dismissal behavior and backend actions are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No downtime or migration is required.

manual.detail: No user action is required. Middle-click on Inbox rows and card [x] buttons now dismisses the item; requests are dismissed immediately without confirmation.

recovery.detail: No recovery changes; existing dismissal and read actions are reused.
